question: Should the two production finalization messages added by this PR be treated as terminal failed publish-attempt states?
rationale: The code change is narrow and appears correct, but it changes persistent queue semantics for already accepted staged publish attempts and needs incident/operator intent rather than an automated cleanup close.

options.title: Accept Terminal Classification
options.body: Merge after confirming these messages are deterministic conflicts and failed attempts are the intended operator-visible outcome.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Gate the classifier on more context or typed errors if either message could represent a retryable upstream, storage, or runtime condition.

options.title: Defer To Incident Work
options.body: Leave this PR open while the broader staged prepublication recovery issue defines the permanent retryable-versus-terminal state model.

recommendation.title: Accept Terminal Classification
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming these messages are deterministic conflicts and failed attempts are the intended operator-visible outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently repaired the staged prepublication finalization path and authored the broader incident context.
